verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs explicitly say you can follow an agent's progress live, send a correction while it is working, or queue up its next task. That is the core of steering an active session without restarting. Persistent conversation history across restarts reinforces continuity. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the mid-run steering mechanism (API/SDK/CLI endpoint for injecting messages, semantics of interrupt vs. queue), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
Agents keep their conversation history across crashes, restarts, and machine disconnects, so work can resume without starting a new conversation.
